name: Feed-Forward Hierarchical Gaussian Diffusion
definition: A reconstruction method that uses two explicit Gaussian banks (structure and detail) initialized from anatomical cues, refined via a sequential structure-to-detail diffusion hierarchy, and rendered into an attenuation field.
summary: Feed-Forward Hierarchical Gaussian Diffusion is a CT reconstruction method that predicts 3D Gaussian primitives from degraded projections using separate structure and detail banks, avoiding per-scene optimization.
